drmundo__yuumi.notes:
- Yuumi's poke and heal sustain make extended trades unfavorable; dodge her Q projectiles always
- Play safe, farm from distance, let Yuumi push; punish her ally's mistakes only
- Never chase Yuumi into brush; bait her Q then all-in her immobilized ally
- Post-six, Yuumi's ult roots you; position behind minions and time your E engage carefully
- First item spike is real threat; farm safely and scale, don't force fights early
- Mid-game teamfights when Yuumi leaves her ally; chase isolated targets and maximize Mundo pressure
- Slow-push waves into tower; forces Yuumi to commit resources, creates pick windows for you
- Take Grasp for sustain trades and scaling; Stormraider's Surge tempting but Grasp wins long-term
- Buy Abyssal Mask second or third; reduces her healing output and amplifies your damage significantly

drmundo__mordekaiser.notes:
- Mordekaiser's all-in combo with E-Q-R oneshots you if you're caught without escape tools
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid his E pull range and farm from distance with Q
- Bait his E, then all-in with your tankiness; dodge his Q shockwave when possible
- Respect his ultimate—you cannot fight him inside it; play around cooldown timers carefully
- His first item spike (Rylai's) is dangerous; play safer and stack resistances immediately after
- You spike harder than him mid-game with multiple resistances and sustained damage output
- Slow-push into him to deny his all-in engage while maintaining escape route safety
- Grasp of the Undying provides sustain to survive his poke and scale better
- Kaenic Lifeburst converts his magic damage into your healing and amplifies your tankiness significantly

drmundo__jarvaniv.notes:
- Jarvan's early armor and burst damage threaten Mundo's health before scaling kicks in.
- Jarvan spikes level 6; punish him pre-6 and when his ult is down.
- Bait Jarvan's EQ combo, then all-in while cooldowns reset and Mundo regenerates.
- Build Kaenic Lifeburst early if Jarvan stacks armor; amplifies your true damage output.

drmundo__lux.notes:
- Lux's binding root and followup combo burst kills you if you get caught immobile
- Play safe behind minions early; dodge her Q at all costs with unpredictable movement
- Never trade when her Q is up; bait it out, then all-in short trades
- Post-6 her ult threatens you constantly; play around fog of war and respect its range
- Her Liandry's spike at first item hurts; abuse her before it completes fully
- Level 9+ you outscale hard; extend teamfights and force her to use ult defensively
- Slow-push to deny her easy rotation angles; control wave near your tower safety
- Grasp for sustained lane dominance and healing to offset her poke and burst damage
- Adaptive Helm blocks her magic damage and reduces ult effectiveness; buy it third or fourth

drmundo__draven.notes:
- Draven's early all-in damage and axe resets snowball into unstoppable late-game carry threat.
- Draven spikes level 2-3; punish him post-6 when Mundo gains sustain and tankiness.
- Bait Draven's all-in by walking up, then cleanse with Mundo's passive and outheal.
- Build Spirit Visage early if Draven gets ahead; amplifies your healing against his burst.

drmundo__briar.notes:
- Briar's all-in burst and healing reduction from Wound Psych shred your sustain hard
- Play safe, farm under tower, avoid her Q-W poke combo at level two
- Bait her Q charges then trade back; dodge her dash with your positioning
- Her ultimate gives her engage tool; respect range, position deeper in lane after six
- First Mythic spike around thirteen minutes is dangerous; don't fight her during this window
- Post-first-item you outscale; farm safely until then and punish her if she roams
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces her to choose between farm and roaming tendency
- Grasp for sustain in short trades; it helps offset her damage and poke pressure
- Add Thornmail early if ahead; it scales your tankiness and punishes her aggression further

drmundo__thresh.notes:
- Thresh hook one-shots you if caught; respect hook range and never stay predictable
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm from max range and dodge toward lane walls constantly
- Bait his hook by moving erratically, then trade with Cleaver when he misses
- Mundo ult at six lets you sustain his poke; he gains nothing significant
- His Frostfire spike around 800 gold hurts; punish by all-inning before he completes
- Post-nine minutes when your Liandry stacks; he cannot duel you anymore at all
- Slow-push to deny him hook angles; force him to overextend into your jungler
- Take Grasp for consistent healing against poke; scales better than Stormraider's Surge here
- Buy Force of Nature early if hooked repeatedly; the magic resist and move speed help

drmundo__xerath.notes:
- Xerath locks you down with long-range poke; dodge his Q skillshot relentlessly or die.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his range and farm from max distance with cleaver.
- Bait his Q by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's on cooldown immediately.
- Post-6 his ult becomes oppressive; hug walls and use bushes to block sight lines.
- First item (Luden's) spike is dangerous; avoid extended fights and farm safely for scaling.
- Level 9+ and two items give you tankiness to duel; punish his immobility then.
- Slow-push waves into him; forces him closer or lets you freeze near your tower.
- Take Grasp to sustain his poke damage and scale into a unkillable teamfight monster.
- Add Adaptive Helm second or third; it cuts his damage and lets you stay relevant.

drmundo__urgot.notes:
- Urgot's shotgun knees proc and his execute ult instantly delete you if caught.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his damage and abuse range. Farm at distance.
- Bait his E cooldown, then trade with Cleaver. Never fight inside his effective range.
- Urgot gains kill pressure; his ult executes at low health. Play around fog of war.
- His Manamune spike hurts; play safer, stack HP, avoid extended trades when he completes it.
- Post-Sunfire, you outdamage and outlast him in prolonged fights. Abuse this window to dominate.
- Slow-push waves into tower; this denies his gank setup and lets you scale safely.
- Take Grasp for sustained healing in extended trades and better scaling into late game.
- Buy Hollow Radiance early; the magic resist and CDR reduce his poke and ult threat.

drmundo__caitlyn.notes:
- Caitlyn's poke and trap zoning force you into lethal headshot range repeatedly
- Play safe level 1-3, farm with cleaver from max range, dodge traps
- Never trade after she lands a trap; bait her net, then all-in
- Caitlyn gains kill pressure with ult; respect its range, hide behind minions
- Her first item spike (RFC/Manamune) increases poke range; farm safely, don't fight
- All-in windows open when Caitlyn wastes net or trap; go full aggressive
- Slow-push waves into her so she must choose between farm and trading
- Grasp provides sustain against poke and extra tankiness for extended trades
- Add Kaenic Lifeburst early if poke becomes unbearable; it shreds her poke

drmundo__irelia.notes:
- Irelia's dash-and-stun combo closes gaps fast; dodge her Q resets or get stunned repeatedly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her early damage and mobility beat you—farm with Q from range.
- Bait her E stun, then all-in with Mundo ultimate; avoid trading during her Q resets.
- Her ultimate strengthens her dueling significantly; respect her damage spike and play around cooldowns.
- First item Trinity Force or Sunfire spike is real danger; farm safely and scale harder.
- Post-first-item, your tankiness and healing edge her out; all-in when her cooldowns are down.
- Slow-push waves toward her; this denies her roam leverage and lets you scale safely.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health stacking; Stormraider's Surge works but feels secondary here.
- Add Force of Nature early if she's ahead; the magic resist and move speed help immensely.

drmundo__masteryi.notes:
- Master Yi's sustained auto-attack damage and on-hit resets will shred your health bar relentlessly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid extended trades near minions where Yi stacks his passive.
- Bait his Q with unpredictable movement, then all-in with Mundo Cleavers during cooldown.
- Post-6 Yi becomes extremely slippery; your damage window closes significantly after his ultimate activates.
- First item Kraken Slayer spike around 10-12 minutes forces you to respect his damage threshold.
- Punish window exists immediately after Yi uses Q or ultimate; commit to all-in trading then.
- Slow-push waves to deny Yi reset opportunities; stack minions at your tower for safety.
- Take Grasp of the Undying for sustain trading and health scaling into late game.
- Rush Force of Nature second to amplify magic resist and reduce his on-hit percentage damage.

drmundo__leona.notes:
- Leona's all-in CC chain and armor shred burst — avoid getting caught by her combo
- Play safe levels 1-3; her passive trades win; farm from distance, don't fight early
- Bait her E engages near minions, then disengage; never stand still for her full combo
- Her ultimate creates teamfight pressure; you become vulnerable to her E-Q chain initiation pattern
- Her Sunfire/Hollow Radiance spike hurts; play safer farming, wait for her to burn cooldowns first
- You spike harder mid-game when tanky; all-in her when she wastes E or R cooldown
- Slow-push side lanes to control wave; this prevents her roaming and teamfight initiations from river
- Take Grasp for scaling and sustain; you need healing to offset her true damage poke
- Build Hollow Radiance early; its magic resist directly counters her Sunfire and burst damage pattern

drmundo__tristana.notes:
- Tristana's attack range and rocket jump allow her to kite and burst you down easily.
- Play safe early; her damage outpaces yours. Farm at range, avoid her all-in trades completely.
- Never chase her; bait her rocket jump, then engage. Dodge her E explosions when possible.
- Her ultimate knockback denies your engages. Play around it; don't face-check without ultimate advantage.
- Tristana's first item spike (Kraken/Galeforce) is dangerous. Respect it; farm safely and stack HP.
- Your power window is mid-game when you're tanky. Group and use ultimate to lock targets.
- Slow-push waves into her to control spacing and force her to interact with you awkwardly.
- Use Grasp for sustain and scaling; it turns her poke into your healing advantage over time.
- Build Adaptive Helm early to reduce her explosive damage and gain MR for her late-game scaling.

drmundo__lillia.notes:
- Lillia kites you endlessly with MS and deals true damage over time.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her poke outdamages yours. Farm at range with Q.
- Never chase Lillia into her kited space. Bait her W, then all-in.
- Her ult forces you to disengage or die. Play around cooldown timers strictly.
- Watch for Liandry's spike around 10-12 minutes; her true damage ramps hard then.
- You spike post-Hollow Radiance when her percent damage matters less to your bulk.
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces her to engage on your terms or lose CS.
- Take Grasp for sustain and durability against her poke-heavy sustained damage approach.
- Build Hollow Radiance early as third item to reduce her percentage-based true damage.

drmundo__swain.notes:
- Swain root chains you then bursts with ult; you can't kite or escape his full combo
- Play safe early; his E root is slow but deadly; farm from distance, avoid extended trades
- Bait his E root by moving unpredictably, then all-in him while it's down; dodge his Q
- Swain ult turns him into sustained damage threat; your regen barely keeps up with drain
- Swain's first item (Liandry's or Rylai's) spike hurts hard; farm safely and scale instead
- Post-15 minutes you outscale; build tankier and kite around team fights where he can't chain you
- Slow-push side lanes; Swain struggles chasing you through minion waves; keep spacing advantage always
- Take Grasp for healing sustain; you need health regen to out-trade his poke damage
- Build Force of Nature after core; magic resist and movespeed let you dodge his roots

drmundo__yone.notes:
- Yone's extended range and mobility let him kite you relentlessly while dealing consistent damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; avoid pushing up. Farm defensively and respect his early poke range.
- Bait his E-W combo, then all-in when he commits. Never chase into his spirit.
- Post-6 Yone ult is a hard engage tool; play around vision and stay grouped.
- His first-item spike (usually Shieldbow) makes him durable; abuse him before he finishes it.
- You spike harder mid-game when tanky. Group with team and force 5v5 fights post-15min.
- Slow-push to stack wave, then all-in when he's forced to interact with minions.
- Take Grasp for sustain in poke trades and scaling strength in extended fights.
- Buy Force of Nature early if he stacks magic damage; otherwise prioritize tankiness items.

drmundo__fiora.notes:
- Fiora's Vitals proc true damage and true damage scaling, ignoring your tankiness entirely
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge her poke, farm at range, avoid all-ins before level 4
- Never trade into her after Vital procs; bait her into missing Parry on your Cleaver
- Post-6 her ult heals and resets Vitals; you cannot duel her in prolonged fights anymore
- First item Trinity gives her sustained true damage; this window forces you to respect range
- You spike when you complete Hollow Radiance; it slows her attack speed and her burst
- Slow-push waves into her; she cannot shove fast enough and eventually you'll crash for all-in
- Take Grasp for survivability and healing; Fiora's true damage demands extra sustain and tankiness
- Build Kaenic Frostbite early as fourth item; it reduces her healing and her Vital procs

drmundo__jinx.notes:
- Jinx's long-range rockets and execute damage burst you down before you can close gap
- Play safe near minions; avoid extended trades where she lands multiple rocket hits on you
- Bait her rockets by moving unpredictably, then all-in when she's on minigun with short range
- Her ultimate becomes a zoning tool; respect the damage but don't play passively in lane
- First Manamune spike makes her waveclear scary; abuse weak early game before she scales up
- Mid-game teamfights where Jinx lacks peel; run her down with ult and close distance
- Slow-push and stack waves so she must choose between farming and defending tower
- Grasp sustains your health pool against her poke and strengthens your all-in potential
- Adaptive Helm reduces her rocket damage and provides magic resist for her execute threshold

drmundo__illaoi.notes:
- Illaoi tentacles and E spirit grab burst you down or create unfavorable all-ins instantly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, avoid her melee range entirely.
- Bait her E tentacle swings, dodge them, then trade short with Q and cleaver.
- Illaoi's ultimate at six lets her kite and heal; avoid extended fights in ult.
- Her first item spike (Sunderer or Stridebreaker) is dangerous; play safe, farm, scale up.
- Power spike comes mid-game when you have two items and magic resist; abuse then.
- Slow-push waves into her to deny tentacle spawns and set up jungle ganks safely.
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke pressure that matches her lane presence better.
- Build Force of Nature third item if she stacks heavy magic damage and healing.

drmundo__tahmkench.notes:
- Tahm's gray health and W tongue stun lock you down; avoid his engage range entirely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his poke range and don't get caught near minions.
- Never trade when his passive gray health is up; wait for it to expire first.
- Post-6, Tahm gains map pressure; play toward river vision and respect his roaming threat.
- His first item (Hollow Radiance) spike hurts; use this window to farm safely and scale.
- Dr. Mundo spikes at Liandry's; abuse his immobility then with aggressive sustained damage trades.
- Slow-push waves into him; deny his all-in range while setting up jungle ganks.
- Take Grasp for sustain and winning extended trades after his gray health window closes.
- Buy Force of Nature early if ahead; the magic resist and move speed kites tongue.

drmundo__lissandra.notes:
- Lissandra's all-in combo with E-W-R locks you down; you cannot cleanse or escape mid-chain.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her poke range and don't greedily trade near minions.
- Bait her E cooldown by moving unpredictably, then all-in before she can kite or chain.
- Post-6 her ultimate becomes a hard reset tool; you lose all-in potential when it's up.
- Lissandra's first item spike (Liandry or Everfrost) is dangerous; play safer and scale instead.
- Dr. Mundo's window opens mid-game when Lissandra runs out of mana or cooldowns are staggered.
- Slow-push waves into tower so she cannot roam freely and you maintain lane control safely.
- Take Grasp for sustain; healing lets you out-trade her long-term poke and scale harder.
- Buy Adaptive Helm after Hollow Radiance to reduce her repeated ability damage and spike threat.

drmundo__morgana.notes:
- Morgana's binding roots you; you can't cleanse it, so positioning matters critically here.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her binding range and farm from max distance safely.
- Bait her binding by moving unpredictably, then all-in when she misses and cooldown resets.
- Post-6 her ultimate is lockdown; stay spread and use your ultimate defensively for teamfights.
- Her first item (Liandry's or Zhonya's) spikes around 10-12 minutes; farm safely, don't fight then.
- Your power window is mid-game when you're tankier; all-in when her binding is down.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roam and maintain pressure; she wants to roam.
- Pick Grasp for sustained trading and tank scaling; it's your best laning tool here.
- Buy Adaptive Helm after core items; it reduces her poke and burst significantly.

drmundo__garen.notes:
- Garen's silence and true damage execute ult instantly delete you without counterplay.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his short cooldowns punish early aggression hard.
- Never trade when his Q is up; dodge it, then all-in.
- Garen ult at six becomes kill threat; respect it and play back.
- His first item spike is real danger; farm safely and scale instead.
- You outscale massively; farm safely and punish him overextending after teamfights.
- Slow-push to stack wave; forces him to commit or lose turret pressure.
- Grasp sustain keeps you healthy through his repeated short trades and poke.
- Build Force of Nature early if he stacks damage; blocks his execute.

drmundo__veigar.notes:
- Veigar's Event Horizon stun cage traps you; his Primordial Burst ultimate deletes health instantly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm ranged minions from distance; dodge his Q poke attempts.
- Bait Event Horizon by walking into it, then immediately cleanse or dash out quickly.
- Post-6 Veigar becomes lethal; his ultimate scales with AP; stay behind minions always now.
- First item Luden's or Everfrost around 2:30 is danger window; respect his burst damage.
- Push lane hard post-6 when Veigar backs; deny him CS and roam opportunities freely.
- Slow-push into him; deny Veigar safe farming; force him to overextend for minions.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; it helps you survive his poke and scaling.
- Buy Adaptive Helm third item; its passive blocks his repeated burst and reduces ultimate damage.

drmundo__amumu.notes:
- Amumu's bandage toss stun locks you down; his ult engages entire team fights.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Amumu outtraces early. Farm under tower, avoid pushing forward.
- Bait his bandage toss by moving unpredictably; trade only after he misses cooldown.
- Post-6 Amumu becomes teamfight threat. Avoid clustered positioning; split push or kite backwards.
- Amumu's Liandry spike (first-second item) hurts; abuse window before he completes it fully.
- Dr. Mundo outscales mid-game; punish when Amumu wastes ult on teammates, not you.
- Slow-push waves into him; this denies bandage toss engagement and lets you scale safely.
- Pick Grasp for sustain and poke; Amumu can't all-in you when you're healthy.
- Buy early Adaptive Helm after core; reduces his Liandry burn and ult damage significantly.

drmundo__brand.notes:
- Brand's stun combos and persistent DoT burn chunk you hard; respect his range
- Play safe levels 1-3; Brand out-trades you early; farm from distance, avoid close fights
- Dodge his Pillar stun at all costs; bait it before all-ins; never chase
- Post-6, Brand ult bounces and stuns; you become a bounce target; play around team
- Brand spikes hard at Liandry's; respect his damage; this is a gank-vulnerable window
- You spike at 2-3 items when tankiness outscales his damage; all-in post-6 teamfights then
- Slow-push to stack wave; Brand struggles into large waves; forces him to commit
- Take Grasp; sustain and tankiness counter his poke and burn pressure best
- Buy Adaptive Helm after first defensive item; reduces his DoT and ult bounce damage

drmundo__jax.notes:
- Jax stun locks you down after dodging your cleaver, then beats you in extended fights
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with cleaver from distance, avoid all-ins before level 6
- Bait his counterstrike with cleaver, then all-in when it's on cooldown; never chase
- You outscale him massively at 6; ultimate sustain negates his burst, initiate fights then
- Jax first item spike (trinity) is dangerous; play safer, respect his damage window hard
- Post-15 minutes when you have two items, Jax cannot duel you; abuse this power
- Slow-push side lanes to deny him easy wave manipulation; group with team for teamfights
- Grasp of the Undying sustains you through early poke and wins short trades consistently
- Adaptive Helm after your core items reduces his on-hit magic damage from triforce significantly

drmundo__rell.notes:
- Rell's mounted engage and E stun lock you down; respect her all-in threat range always
- Play safe level 1-3; dodge her mounted charges, farm at range, don't contest short trades
- Bait her E stun by moving unpredictably, then all-in when she dismounts and loses mobility
- Rell's mounted form ult lockdown becomes lethal; respect teamfight positioning and play around dismounted windows
- Her first item spike (Sunfire or mythic) increases her engage damage; farm safely, don't fight yet
- Post-dismount when her E is down; Dr. Mundo dominates extended trades and 1v1 duels then
- Slow-push waves into her; force her to choose between helping roams or losing tower pressure
- Grasp of the Undying sustains through poke and strengthens short trades when she dismounts
- Force of Nature first if she stacks magic damage heavy; always protects scaling and teamfight survival

drmundo__ashe.notes:
- Ashe kites you endlessly with slows; her poke whittles you down before teamfights.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her range and avoid walking into her auto-attack range.
- Trade only after she wastes arrows; dodge her slows by moving unpredictably sideways.
- Her ultimate severely limits your engage; wait for cooldown before forcing all-ins.
- Ashe's first item (Manamune or Runaan's) spike is dangerous; farm safely and scale.
- You spike harder at three items with CDR; use this to run her down.
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces her to choose between defending turret or grouping.
- Take Grasp for sustain and scaling; you need extra durability against poke damage.
- Buy Force of Nature if her full team stacks magic; otherwise rush Hollow Radiance.

drmundo__warwick.notes:
- Warwick all-ins with Execute damage and lifesteal; dodge his Q to survive
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Cleaver, avoid extended trades
- Bait his Q then trade back; use Cleaver to kite his engage attempts
- Warwick ult locks you down; position near walls to minimize gank setup angles
- His first Mythic spike is dangerous; farm safely and scale into your tankiness
- You spike harder at two items; sustain through his damage and outlast him
- Slow-push waves to control gank timing and force him to farm safely
- Grasp of the Undying for sustained lane pressure and health scaling advantage
- Spirit Visage provides early MR and amplifies your healing against his burst combo

drmundo__ezreal.notes:
- Ezreal kites you endlessly with Q spam while staying out of your effective range always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his Qs, farm at max range, don't chase trades early.
- Bait his Q with sidestep movements, then all-in when he mispositions; avoid his E escape.
- Post-6 his ult zones you harder; respect damage but continue farming safely; gank becomes viable.
- First Manamune spike hurts; he chunks you harder at range—punish his mana-gate windows instead.
- Win condition: catch him out of position mid-game when his E is down or cooldown.
- Slow-push waves into him; forces him to farm closer, creates gank setup for your jungler.
- Take Grasp; sustained healing sustains through poke, makes you harder to whittle down over time.
- Build Force of Nature second; massive MR stacks reduce his burst damage significantly through the game.

drmundo__zaahen.notes:
- Zaahen's sustained damage and kite potential forces you to commit fully or disengage completely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Cleaver, avoid all-ins before level 6 power.
- Bait Zaahen's abilities with movement, then all-in with Mundo ult; never trade evenly without ult.
- Post-6 you gain massive sustain and tankiness; look to force extended fights where you dominate.
- First item spike (likely Mythic) is dangerous; respect it but your ult sustain outscales it.
- Dominate mid-game teamfights when Zaahen lacks defensive items; your healing overwhelms their sustained damage output.
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces Zaahen to choose between farm and harassment, gaining you tempo.
- Grasp for extended trading power and survivability; scales better into late-game tank role than alternatives.
- Build Hollow Radiance early if Zaahen stacks ability power; reduces their poke damage significantly.

drmundo__singed.notes:
- Singed proxies waves and kites you forever; his poison damage and speed deny your close combat advantage completely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his poison damage and don't chase him into lane brush where he controls space.
- Dodge his fling by positioning near minions; never trade when he's near his tower—he wins extended poison skirmishes easily.
- Post-6 his ult makes him unkillable in extended fights; abuse windows when it's down to force favorable trades.
- His first item Rylai's spike is dangerous; he kites harder and sticks poison longer, reducing your all-in windows significantly.
- Your power window is early game before Rylai's; all-in him levels 4-5 with Mundo ult before his scaling takes over.
- Slow-push waves into tower; forces him to either proxy further or lose CS, reducing his safety and economy pressure.
- Pick Grasp; the sustain and poke help you survive poison trades and convert lane presence into late-game tankiness advantage.
- Buy Mercury's Treads early if proxy-heavy; the tenacity reduces his slow uptime and lets you actually approach him in fights.

drmundo__missfortune.notes:
- Miss Fortune's poke damage and ultimate channel lock down destroy you if caught immobile.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Q, avoid her auto-attack range entirely.
- Bait her Double Up bounces, then all-in with E when she repositions or wastes it.
- Her ultimate forces you to move or die; stay mobile and use your tankiness.
- First Manamune spike around 800 gold hurts; abuse your sustain and farm safely through it.
- Level 9+ with Liandry's and grievous sources lets you out-duel and out-sustain her poke.
- Slow-push side lanes to force her to choose between defending and grouping for fights.
- Grasp rewards short trades and sustain differences; synergizes better than Stormraider's Surge here.
- Adaptive Helm third item blocks her poke spam and reduces her ultimate's burn damage.

drmundo__qiyana.notes:
- Qiyana's burst combo and root lock you down; dodge her empowered Q and E engage
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her damage and don't overextend near river brush positioning
- Bait her Q with positioning, then trade back with E; dodge her E engage attempts
- Her ultimate creates major gank setup and burst potential; play safer and ward accordingly
- Her first item spike (Duskblade) is dangerous; respect her damage and play extra cautiously
- Post-first-item, you outscale her; use tankiness and ultimate to teamfight and absorb burst
- Slow-push waves to deny her roam opportunities; prevent her from rotating to gank lanes
- Take Grasp for sustainability and health stacking against her poke and burst damage pattern
- Add Adaptive Helm third or fourth to reduce her burst and persistent ability damage

drmundo__kayn.notes:
- Kayn's burst damage and mobility allow him to all-in and escape before you land meaningful retaliation.
- Play safe and farm. Kayn lacks early pressure; use this to stack Grasp and build health advantage.
- Bait his Shadowstep dash toward you, then immediately E away. Never chase him into walls or fog.
- Kayn's transformation makes him stronger. Play cautiously until you gauge whether he went Blue or Red form.
- First item spike is dangerous. Kayn gains significant burst—play safer near walls and avoid overextending for kills.
- Mid-game when Kayn rotates, you have a window. Mundo dominates isolated targets without Kayn's team backup.
- Slow-push waves into him. Forces Kayn to farm under tower; reduces his roam and gank frequency.
- Grasp of the Undying. Sustain and strength scaling let you outscale Kayn's early-to-mid game threat.
- Hollow Radiance. Reduces Kayn's ability power damage and gives armor—essential against both Red and Blue form.

drmundo__xayah.notes:
- Xayah's feathered root chains you down, preventing escape and enabling ally burst damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3. Farm at range with Q. Avoid pushing lane near her.
- Dodge her E root by moving unpredictably. Trade only when her feathers are spent.
- Xayah gains escape and damage at six. Play further back; gank becomes more dangerous.
- Her first item spike (Kraken) at 1-2 items is a major danger window for you.
- You spike at three items or teamfights where she cannot kite your frontline forever.
- Slow-push and stack waves. Force her to overextend or lose minions to tower safely.
- Take Grasp. Sustains your lane and ensures you win extended trades despite her poke.
- Build Force of Nature second or third item to reduce her sustained damage output significantly.

drmundo__nami.notes:
- Nami's bubble stun and poke combo catch you out of position; respect her range always
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q bubble outranges your engage, so farm passively under tower
- Dodge her Q bubble by moving unpredictably; bait it out before committing to trade damage

- Play safe levels 1-3; Amumu out-damages you early, so respect his all-in potential
- Never trade into his Despair tick damage; bait his Bandage Toss and punish with Q
- Post-6 Amumu becomes a teamfight monster; stick to split-push and use Taunt to counter-engage
- First Liandry's spike around 11 minutes is dangerous; respect his burst and roam timing
- Your window is levels 4-5 before his cooldowns reset; pressure and secure objectives then
- Slow-push sideways; deny him easy Bandage Toss targets and force him to commit
- Take Grasp for sustain and early poke; winning short trades keeps you healthy and pressured
- Add Adaptive Helm later; reduces his Despair burn and mitigates teamfight poke damage significantly

shen__teemo.notes:
- Teemo's poison and shroom denial zone forces you to respect his poke range constantly
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his autos, CS at max range, avoid pushing early
- Bait his Q with movement, then all-in when it's down; never trade into poison stacks
- Taunt becomes less effective post-6 as Teemo uses shrooms to kite and escape engages
- His first Nashor's Tooth spike hurts you hard; punish before completion with aggressive roams
- Post-first-back when Teemo lacks mana; all-in aggressively before he gets items and mana pool
- Slow-push to stack minions, then crash for roam pressure; denies his poke safety and tempo
- Take Grasp for healing sustain against his poke; the extra damage helps duel him pre-6
- Rush Adaptive Helm after Sunfire to reduce poison damage and shroom effectiveness significantly overall

shen__seraphine.notes:
- threat: Seraphine chains you with root then bursts; avoid her Q-E combo range entirely
- early: Play safe; her poke outdamages you early; farm from max range, dodge her abilities
- trading: Bait her E root, then all-in with Q-E-W when she's on cooldown only
- post6: Her ultimate roots entire team; respect it, split safely, never group in chokepoints
- spike: First Mythic (Liandry's) hits hard around 11 minutes; respect her damage, don't duel
- window: Level 4-5 before her E maxes; trade hard then; also post-6 during her ult cooldown
- wave: Slow-push into her; she'll shove back, then roam bot; you follow with teleport
- rune: Stormraider's Surge; it lets you escape her root chain and kite her poke safely
- item: Kaenic Lifegrip into her; healing cuts her burst, gives you stats and active shield boost

shen__fizz.notes:
- Fizz all-in burst with Protobelt active into Shark ult kills you before Taunt connects.
- Play safe, farm from distance, dodge Fizz spear poke, respect his level 2 all-in threat.
- Bait his Trickster dash, then Taunt him; never trade when his abilities are up cooldown-wise.
- Post-six, Shark ult forces you to ult away or die; play around cooldown timers carefully.
- Protobelt spike around six-to-eight minutes creates lethal threat; don't fight; roam or scale instead.
- After Fizz burns Shark cooldown, you have fifteen-second window to pressure or roam bot lane.
- Slow-push waves into tower to deny Fizz roam angles and create gank safety for yourself.
- Take Grasp for durability and scaling; the sustained healing negates his repeated poke damage.
- Adaptive Helm second item blocks his AP burst and Shark damage; delays lethal threat window.

drmundo__pyke.notes:
- Pyke's hook one-shots you or sets up guaranteed execute ultimate kill pressure
- Play safe behind minions; dodge hook by standing beside wave, not in lane
- Never trade after missing hook cooldown; bait hook then all-in with Cleaver
- Pyke gains kill threat; respect execute range and play around map visibility
- Pyke's Duskblade spike is dangerous; farm safely and don't overextend without vision
- You outscale and outduel him post-first-item; force extended fights when possible always
- Slow-push into him; deny his roam timer and force him to choose engage
- Take Grasp for sustain and duel pressure; Stormraider's Surge wastes slot against him
- Buy Hollow Radiance early; its armor and heal reduction counter his burst damage

drmundo__twistedfate.notes:
- Gold Card stun locks you down; avoid clustered minions near Twisted Fate
- Play safe; farm at range with Cleaver; dodge his Q poke
- Bait Gold Card with sidestepping, then all-in; never trade into his combo
- His ult enables ganks; play safer and ward; he roams frequently now
- First Sheen spike hurts; respect his damage; don't force extended trades then
- Mid-game teamfights where he's isolated; all-in him before Gold Card lands
- Slow-push waves into him; force him to shove; creates gank vulnerability
- Grasp sustains through poke; grants scaling and trading power he can't match
- Adaptive Helm blocks his repeated damage; reduces Magic Pen effectiveness significantly

drmundo__kogmaw.notes:
- Kog'Maw's on-hit magic damage and range overwhelm Mundo's tankiness; kite and poke from distance relentlessly.
- Play safe early; his range outmatches yours. Farm defensively, dodge his Q, don't force extended trades.
- Bait his W toggle off, then all-in with cleaver spam and Infected Cleaver slow.
- Post-6 his ultimate range increases massively; respect distance, use bushes, and play around cooldowns carefully.
- His first Manamune spike hurts significantly; respect his damage window and play more evasively then.
- Around level 9-11 your tankiness peaks relative to his scaling; abuse cooldown advantages before he itemizes.
- Slow-push to stack waves; forces him to choose between farming and poking, reducing his effectiveness.
- Take Grasp for sustain and trading power; healing matters more than Stormraider's Surge kiting here.
- Build Abyssal Mask second to reduce his magic damage and amplify your own cleaver damage output.

drmundo__aurora.notes:
- Aurora's CC chain and burst combo lock you down; respect her stun range always
- Play safe levels 1-3; her poke outdamages your sustain early; farm defensively near tower
- Dodge her Q stun projectile; bait her E dash into your Q; never trade extended
- Post-6 her ultimate gank setup threatens you hard; play safer and ward aggressively
- Her first item spike around 1200g punishes; avoid extended trades; focus on farming safely
- Exploit her cooldowns post-level 9; all-in when her stun is down; abuse mana constraints
- Slow-push sidewaves to deny her roam; stack minions before tower; don't hard push mid
- Take Grasp for sustain dueling; her short trades favor Stormraider's Surge but you need health
- Build Adaptive Helm second after Sunfire; reduces her burst and negates her AP scaling threat

drmundo__soraka.notes:
- Soraka's silence and poke from range make trading difficult; respect her damage output.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range and avoid her Q harassment patterns.
- Bait her silence with fake engages, then all-in when cooldown expires immediately.
- Her ultimate negates your burst potential; coordinate kills before she reaches level 6 safely.
- First item Staff spike hurts; use this window to scale and farm safely instead.
- Mid-game teamfights favor you when Soraka is caught; punish her positioning relentlessly then.
- Slow-push waves to deny her roaming and force her to manage lane pressure.
- Take Grasp for sustain trading and late-game tankiness against her poke harassment pattern.
- Consider Adaptive Helm second to reduce her sustained magic damage and silence spam effectiveness.

drmundo__kindred.notes:
- Kindred's burst and kiting chain you down; their marks grant scaling you cannot match.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Cleaver, avoid extended trades near walls.
- Bait their Q with positioning; trade when they land, then disengage immediately after.
- Kindred gains mobility and burst; your ult sustain matters more; play teamfight-focused after six.
- Their first item spike (Duskblade/Trinity) is dangerous; respect their burst window around minute nine.
- Mid-game teamfights are your window; group and force five-versus-five where their kiting hurts less.
- Slow-push side lanes; force Kindred to choose between farming or stopping your wave pressure.
- Take Grasp for extended trading sustain; it helps you survive their poke and rotations.
- Thornmail cripples their attack speed; add it third or fourth to reduce their duel threat.

drmundo__gwen.notes:
- Gwen's true damage and attack speed shred chunks your health faster than you heal
- Play safe behind minions; her Q range forces respect but avoid her marked bushes early
- Never trade when she has passive stacks; bait her Q sideways then all-in her
- Her ult gives all-in kill pressure; respect the range and play around cooldown timers
- Gwen's Nashors spike hurts hard; play safer farming when she completes it around nine minutes
- You spike harder at two items; all-in her before she gets full build items online
- Slow-push waves to deny her roams and force her to push back into your tower
- Take Grasp for healing sustain; you need the bonus health to mitigate her true damage
- Build Hollow Radiance earlier than usual; the magic resist and heal reduction denial matters significantly

drmundo__volibear.notes:
- Volibear's all-in flip combo kills you fast; respect his engage range always
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm ranged, avoid his tier-two bush; scale up safely
- Bait his flip with positioning; trade when his E is down; dodge flip always
- Mundo gains survivability edge post-6; his ult sustain beats Voli's all-in burst damage
- Volibear spikes hard with Mythic; respect his power; farm safely, don't fight directly
- Mundo dominates mid-game teamfights; Voli falls off; use scaling advantage to outscale him
- Slow-push waves into turret; deny Volibear roam windows; scale safely without fighting him
- Take Grasp for sustain trading; it keeps you healthy in extended short trades
- Buy Force of Nature early; the MR and movespeed counter his flip engage

drmundo__wukong.notes:
- Wukong's burst combo and clone mind-games delete you if caught without cooldowns ready.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q at range, avoid extended trades near minions.
- Bait his E engagement, then trade back with Q-Cleaver; never chase his clone.
- Post-6 Wukong ult is massive AOE CC—play around terrain, use your ult defensively.
- His first item spike (Trinity or Duskblade) is dangerous; respect his all-in threat window.
- You spike harder mid-game when tank items online; abuse his squishiness then relentlessly.
- Slow-push waves to deny his roam value and force him to farm safely.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; Stormraider's Surge risks getting caught by clone feint.
- Buy Adaptive Helm second or third to reduce his ability damage and sustain better.

drmundo__ambessa.notes:
- Ambessa's all-in burst with Q-E combo catches you immobile; respect her engage range always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her early damage is high, farm from distance with Q.
- Bait her Q-E by moving unpredictably; dodge both and she's vulnerable for your all-in.
- Her ultimate gives mobility and damage; play around terrain to minimize her kite potential post-six.
- First item spike (likely Divine or Manamune) strengthens her burst; farm safely, don't fight.
- You outscale significantly after Hollow Radiance; abuse levels 13+ when her burst becomes irrelevant.
- Slow-push side lanes to tank her burst safely; prevent all-in fights where she excels.
- Take Grasp for healing sustain against her poke; lets you survive laning phase comfortably.
- Add Force of Nature early if she's ahead; the magic resist and move speed counter burst.

drmundo__nunuwillump.notes:
- Nunu's CC chain and burst trading windows drain your health faster than you can sustain back.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Nunu out-trades early. Farm at distance and respect his all-in range.
- Dodge his snowball knockup at all costs; bait it out before committing to extended trades.
- Post-6 his ultimate zone control forces you away from fights; maintain distance and play around edges.
- Nunu's first item spike (Liandry's) hurts; respect the damage window but don't panic or overextend.
- Your window opens mid-game when he's on cooldown; punish with aggressive cleaver spam and tank damage.
- Slow-push waves to deny him easy roams; force him to farm or lose minions to tower.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling to match his poke-heavy early laning pressure.
- Buy Force of Nature early if he stacks magic damage; the tenacity and MR help kite.

drmundo__zac.notes:
- Zac's engage with E-W combo locks you down; kite away or die in teamfights
- Play safe level 1-3; Zac out-damages early trades, so farm under tower when pushed
- Bait his E cooldown, then trade back hard; dodge E or he controls the fight
- His ult becomes a teamfight threat; position to avoid getting caught or ulted into enemies
- Zac's first Liandry's is dangerous; play safer but don't let him scale for free
- Punish him when E is down; all-in before level 6 or when he lacks mana
- Slow-push waves to deny his roam impact; keep him under tower farming, delaying teamfights
- Pick Grasp for sustain and poke; Stormraider's Surge works if you need chase/kite tools
- Consider Abyssal Mask early; reduces his burst and helps you survive his combo chain

drmundo__leblanc.notes:
- LeBlanc's burst combo and chain root lock you down before you can react or heal.
- Play safe early; dodge her Q poke. Farm at range with cleavers, avoid close trades.
- Bait her W dash forward, then all-in her. Never trade into her full combo rotation.
- LeBlanc gains kill pressure post-six; respect her mobility and burst. Play around cooldowns strictly.
- Her Luden's spike at first item is dangerous; respect range and never face-check bushes.
- You spike hard at level nine when your cooldowns become oppressive; abuse this window.
- Slow-push to deny her roam pressure and force her to farm or lose CS.
- Grasp; it sustains you through poke and provides tankiness to survive her burst attempts.
- Add Adaptive Helm after core to reduce her burst damage and improve your trading power.

drmundo__kennen.notes:
- Kennen's point-and-click stun locks you down; his burst combo kills immobilized targets instantly.
- Play safe behind minions; Kennen's range outmatches yours early, so avoid extended trades.
- Bait his W auto-reset, then all-in; dodge his E activation window by backing off.
- Kennen's ultimate makes you extremely vulnerable; respect his 6 and play around cooldown.
- His Liandry's spike at two items threatens your health pool; prepare defensive stats then.
- You outscale him mid-game if alive; farming safely gives you win condition later.
- Slow-push sidewaves to force his response; grouping invites his ultimate stun combo into death.
- Take Grasp for sustain and tankiness; Kennen can't burst you while healing consistently.
- Consider Adaptive Helm if his poke overwhelms; it reduces Liandry's damage significantly overall.

drmundo__aphelios.notes:
- Aphelios' long-range damage and root chain severely punish your immobility and low mobility.
- Play safe levels 1-3; his poke outranges you. Farm under tower, avoid unnecessary walks forward.
- Bait his Infernum weapon then all-in; dodge Calibrum shots by moving unpredictably sideways.
- Post-6 his ultimate roots you hard. Use Mundo ult immediately when he engages you.
- First Manamune spike (1100 gold) increases his poke; farm safely, don't trade aggressively then.
- Level 9+ when your E cooldown drops; all-in extended fights when he lacks ammo.
- Slow-push waves into him; forces Aphelios forward into your gank setup and jungle help.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling to mitigate his poke damage overall.
- Buy Adaptive Helm after Hollow Radiance to tank his ability and weapon spam damage.

drmundo__orianna.notes:
- Orianna's Command: Shockwave stuns and chunks you; respect her ball positioning always
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with cleaver; don't chase her poke
- Trade when her ball is far; dodge or tank Q poke, all-in post-6
- Her ultimate becomes a teamfight nuke; stack MR and play around cooldown windows
- First Liandry's spike hurts; farm safely until you complete Hollow Radiance first
- You spike mid-game with tankiness; all-in when her ult is down and cooldown
- Slow-push to deny her roaming; set up jungle ganks on extended waves
- Take Grasp for sustain trading; scales better than Stormraider's Surge into her poke
- Grab Force of Nature second; her damage is magic and it gives movement speed

drmundo__malphite.notes:
- Malphite's point-and-click ultimate locks you down; dodge it or die trying always.
- Play safe levels one through three; avoid extended trades near minion waves early.
- Bait his Q poke, then all-in with E-W; dodge his ultimate at all costs.
- Post-six, respect his ultimate cooldown; play around fog of war and map awareness strictly.
- His armor spike at Sunfire hurts; punish him before he finishes first full item.
- Dr. Mundo spikes harder mid-game with items; abuse levels seven through eleven for kills.
- Slow-push waves into him; force him to choose between wave clear and roaming ganks.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading; it outscales his poke and provides health scaling benefit.
- Buy Void Staff early if ahead; it shreds his stacking armor and improves your dueling.

drmundo__sivir.notes:
- Sivir's poke damage and spell shield block your Q; kite away from teamfights easily
- Play safe and farm from distance; her auto-range beats yours early, avoid extended trades
- Bait her spell shield with Q before committing; dodge her boomerang blade returns carefully
- Mundo gets stronger; use ultimate to engage when she cannot kite backward infinitely anymore
- Her first item (usually Manamune) spikes hard; play defensive and scale into your tankiness advantage
- Mid-game teamfights when Sivir lacks peel; run her down with ultimate movement speed active
- Slow-push toward her tower; force her to choose between farming and grouping for fights
- Grasp of the Undying scales your health and trading; synergizes with your tank playstyle perfectly
- Add Adaptive Helm if she stacks ability power; reduces her poke and spell shield effectiveness

drmundo__gangplank.notes:
- Gangplank's barrel chain and execution damage spike burst you down before you heal enough back
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge barrels at all costs and only farm when kegs are on cooldown
- Never chase Gangplank; bait his barrel placement then all-in before he chains; dodge with Q movement
- Gangplank gains map pressure and execute potential; respect his ultimate and don't fight in its radius
- His first Sheen spike at level 9+ amplifies barrel damage significantly; play defensive during this window
- You spike hardest when Gangplank has no barrels ready; all-in immediately after he detonates his chain
- Slow-push into him; this forces Gangplank to either farm or roam, reducing his barrel setup time
- Grasp of the Undying gives sustain to trade with his poke and sets up all-ins
- Build Adaptive Helm second to reduce his barrel and execute damage while scaling your tankiness further

drmundo__rammus.notes:
- Rammus' Defensive Ball Curl + Puncturing Taunt combo locks you down and reflects damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; don't overextend near Rammus; farm with Cleaver from range.
- Never trade into his Ball Curl active; bait it out, then all-in after cooldown.
- Post-6 his Tremors adds AOE damage; respect it, play around minions, don't face-check.
- Rammus Thornmail spike hurts; this is punish window—abuse him before he completes it.
- Your window: mid-game when he lacks armor items; force extended fights with sustained healing.
- Slow-push waves to build advantage; prevents his engage window and lets you scale safer.
- Grasp procs healing through his reflect; ensures sustain in extended trades post-level 6.
- Maw of Malmortius shields magic from Tremors; grab after core if behind on sustain.

drmundo__hwei.notes:
- Hwei's long-range poke and CC chains chunk you from safety; dodge skillshots relentlessly
- Play safe and farm; Hwei outranges you early, so respect his poke distance
- Bait his skillshots by moving unpredictably, then all-in when he misses crucial spells
- Mundo gains all-in potential post-6; ult sustain lets you absorb Hwei's damage and engage
- Hwei's first item spike (Lost Chapter) hurts; play safer, scale up, prepare counterplay
- Your power window is levels 6-9 when ult sustain outpaces his poke damage output
- Slow-push to stack wave; force Hwei to commit resources, then engage with ult ready
- Take Grasp for sustain and trading potential; it helps offset his poke pressure early
- Build Adaptive Helm second or third to reduce his repeated magic damage significantly

drmundo__vex.notes:
- Vex's fear and burst combo locks you down; respect her all-in potential always
- Play safe; her Q outranges your abilities early, so farm defensively under tower
- Never chase; bait her fear, then all-in with E+Q when she wastes it
- Her ultimate fear creates huge kill pressure; play around fog of war carefully always
- Her first item (Luden's) massively spikes her burst; respect range and play safer then
- Mid-game teamfights favor you; she has no escape once fear is down and used
- Slow-push for ganks; denies her roam pressure and sets up jungle dives easily
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite fear CC and escape her burst rotation safely guaranteed
- Build Adaptive Helm second; it blocks her burst magic damage and negates her poke

drmundo__zilean.notes:
- Zilean's time bomb stun chain locks you down before you can retaliate or escape fights.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his poke range and avoid clumping near minions for bombs.
- Bait his bombs by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Cleaver when his cooldowns reset.
- Post-6 Zilean gains defensive ult; you cannot all-in him anymore without careful positioning planning.
- Zilean's first item spike (Liandrys or Mythic) makes his poke lethal; respect range significantly.
- Window opens mid-game when Zilean lacks mana; force extended fights where sustain dominates his burst.
- Slow-push waves to deny him easy roam opportunities and force him to stay lane.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading pressure and healing to offset his poke damage output.
- Consider early Adaptive Helm to reduce his magic damage and bomb burst significantly.

drmundo__taliyah.notes:
- Taliyah's poke damage and crowd control lock you down before you can close distance safely.
- Play safe behind minions; her Q poke hurts early. Avoid extended trades; farm defensively and heal chip.
- Let her push toward you, then all-in when she's out of position. Dodge her E knockback.
- Post-six her ultimate creates escape routes and gank setup. Play safer; don't overextend near river.
- Her Liandry's and early mana items spike her poke. Farm safely; don't fight in minion wave.
- Mid-game when she runs dry on mana or wastes cooldowns. Chase her down and all-in relentlessly.
- Slow-push to stack minions, then all-in when wave crashes. Forces her into unfavorable fight timing.
- Grasp sustains her poke damage and wins all-in trades. Healing matters more than burst here.
- Buy Hollow Radiance after core items to reduce her spell damage and crowd control duration.

drmundo__nilah.notes:
- Nilah's on-hit damage and lifesteal scaling shreds you; her mobility dodges your abilities easily.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her range and early damage punish aggressive positioning heavily.
- Bait her dash with Cleaver; trade only when she commits to all-in fights.
- Post-6 her ultimate healing makes extended fights unwinnable; play around cooldown windows only.
- First Nashors is her spike; you cannot duel her then, so play safe.
- Your window arrives after two items when tankiness peaks; leverage it before three items.
- Slow-push to stack waves and force her to engage unfavorably near your tower.
- Grasp provides sustain and tankiness to survive her poke and all-in attempts better.
- Kaenic Lifeguard converts her lifesteal against her; buy it early in your rotation.

sivir__sion.notes:
- Sion's charged Q stun locks you down; respects his charge-up range and reposition constantly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his all-in potential if he lands early Q charged.
- Bait his Q charge by walking up, then sidestep hard; punish his long cooldown.
- Post-6 his ult creates gank threat; play safer and group faster for teamfights.
- Sion's Sheen/Trinity first is dangerous; play around vision and avoid extended fights then.
- Mid-game teamfights are your window; kite him with superior range and raw DPS output.
- Slow-push waves to deny his roam; force him to choose between farm and fights.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite and escape his Q lock; speed is your safety.
- Buy Maw second if ahead; gives you the bulk and MR to handle his damage.

sivir__nasus.notes:
- Nasus withers you down then all-ins with ult; his range closes gap instantly.
- Play safe levels 1-3, farm from distance, dodge his E poke with movement.
- Bait his Q cooldown, then trade with W; never fight in his E circle.
- Post-6 his ult makes him tanky and fast; kite backwards, avoid direct engagement.
- Nasus first item spike (sheen/trinity) is dangerous; respect his all-in threat window heavily.
- Your window is early game before trinity and ult; punish him levels 1-5 hard.
- Push wave into tower to deny his Q stacks and force him to choose.
- Lethal Tempo gives you sustained damage in kited fights against his slow ult form.
- Quicksilver Sash counters his wither and lets you escape or kite more freely.

sivir__volibear.notes:
- Volibear all-in after gap close; his sustained damage and CC chain kill you instantly.
- Play safe behind minions; avoid pushing up. Farm with Q from distance, never walk forward.
- Bait his E charge, then sidestep and trade back with Q. Never let him land it.
- His ultimate transforms him into unstoppable threat; respect the all-in range dramatically post-six immediately.
- His first item spike (Sunfire or Trinity) makes him unkillable; abuse him before completing it.
- Mid-game teamfights where he's isolated or low; kite backwards and spam Q for consistent damage.
- Slow-push waves into him; deny his roam and force him to choose farming or fighting.
- Stormraider's Surge gives you kiting tool essential for surviving his gap close and all-in attempts.
- Mercury's Treads into Maw if ahead; the spell shield and tenacity counter his chain CC.

sivir__mordekaiser.notes:
- Mordekaiser all-ins you with E-Q combo; his ult isolates and guarantees kill one-v-one.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range with autos, never walk up for CS.
- Dodge his E pull; trade back with W when he misses, then reposition immediately.
- Post-6 his ult is lethal isolation; never fight alone, always position near teammates for backup.
- His first item spike (Rylai's or Liandry's) around 10-12 minutes; punish him before completion.
- Your window is early teamfights with allies present; he cannot ult multiple people simultaneously then.
- Slow-push waves to stay near your team; never hard-push and get caught alone mid-map.
- Grasp doesn't help; take Stormraider's Surge to kite away from E and escape ult danger.
- Build Force of Nature second if ahead; its MR and movement speed counter his kit hard.

sivir__missfortune.notes:
- Threat: Miss Fortune's double-up bounces and ultimate lockdown burst delete you instantly if caught
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; respect her poke range and never cluster with minions together
- Trading: Dodge her Q bounce by spreading out; bait her E with short trades then back off immediately
- Post6: Her ultimate channels for five seconds dealing massive damage—abuse this by spacing away and flanking side lanes
- Spike: First item spike (Manamune or Dirk) around 10-12 minutes; play safer and respect her poke range then
- Window: You spike at two items with Manamune and crit; push sidelanes and force teamfights on your terms
- Wave: Slow-push to stack waves and crash into tower; prevents her from roaming mid and denies jungle access
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge because it lets you kite her engage and dodge her point-blank ultimate channel attempts
- Item: Add Hexdrinker third or fourth to tank her ultimate burst and reduce all-in damage significantly

drmundo__camille.notes:
- Camille's true damage on-hit and grapple hook lock you down for her burst combo.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her early damage and avoid extended trades near her.
- Bait her grapple onto walls, then punish her cooldown; dodge hookshots with your move speed.
- Mundo ultimate at 6 gives you sustain edge; Camille gains kill pressure with her ult.
- First item Trinity Force spike hurts; play safer then but punish with your tankiness after.
- Mid-game teamfights when Mundo's healing scales—kite backwards, force Camille to commit to you first.
- Slow-push into her to deny grapple wall angles; control wave near river side.
- Grasp of the Undying for sustained trading and health scaling into her poke pressure.
- Consider Hollow Radiance to reduce her true damage burst and shield against her combo.

shen__darius.notes:
- Darius bleeds stacks on you; his five-stack passive dunks you or forces Flash instantly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his all-in range and dodge his outer Q edge.
- Bait his Q then dash in; never trade when his bleed stacks are high.
- Post-6 his execute ult threatens you hard; use your ult to save allies or escape.
- Trinity or Black Cleaver spike makes him tanky and stronger; play around your team fights.
- You spike when allies group; your ult pressure forces him to respect your roam threat.
- Slow-push waves into him; deny him all-in angles and create roam windows for your ult.
- Stormraider's Surge lets you escape his engage and kite his extended combos safely every time.
- Spirit Visage adds health and magic resist; it shores up your survivability against poke squads.

shen__nidalee.notes:
- Nidalee's spear poke forces you to dodge or eat massive damage; respect her range always
- Play safely levels 1-3; farm at max range with Q, avoid her spear trajectory patterns
- Never trade into her; bait spears by moving unpredictably, then all-in when she's on cooldown
- Post-6 Nidalee hunts isolated targets; use your ult to save teammates she dives, not yourself
- First item spike (Lichbane) makes her burst deadly; punish her by grouping and forcing teamfights
- You spike when Nidalee wastes spears; immediately trade or all-in before her next rotation
- Slow-push into her; deny her roam windows and force her to farm under tower pressure
