- Post-6 Kha'Zix gains kill pressure with invisibility; group or play extremely safe
- First item spike (Dirk/Serrated) is dangerous; farm safely and scale into teamfights
- Dr. Mundo wins mid-game teamfights; group proactively once you have decent HP items
- Slow-push to deny isolation kills and force Kha'Zix to fight grouped enemies
- Grasp sustain helps survive poke and repeated skirmishes in extended trades
- Adaptive Helm reduces his evolve Q burst and provides tankiness versus AD spike

drmundo__nidalee.notes:
- Her spear poke from range forces you to dodge or take repeated free damage
- Play safe; dodge spears by positioning behind minions and farm conservatively under tower
- Bait her spear by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Cleaver when she's on cooldown
- Mundo gains kill pressure post-six with ultimate sustain; Nidalee gains chase and burst potential
- Her Lichbane spike at first item hurts; farm safely then punish her if overextended
- Mid-game teamfights favor Mundo when Nidalee wastes spears; gank and force grouped fights
- Slow-push and control mid-lane; deny her space to land spears from fog of war
- Take Grasp for sustain and scaling; helps you survive poke and trade favorably later
- Build Adaptive Helm to block her spell damage and reduce Lichbane burst significantly

sivir__senna.notes:
- Threat: Senna's root snare and poke range punish your positioning; respect her damage.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range with Q, avoid her engage.
- Trading: Dodge her root with movement; bait it before committing to all-in trades.
- Post6: Senna's ult zoning becomes stronger; use your ult to reposition or engage safely.
- Spike: First item spike (Manamune) is dangerous; respect her poke and play behind minions.
- Window: Your power edge comes at two items when you outscale her damage window.
- Wave: Slow-push waves to deny her root setup; control space without overextending forward.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you dodge roots and kite; mobility trumps sustain here.
- Item: Consider Quicksilver Sash early if roots repeatedly catch you; cleanse and reposition.

sivir__annie.notes:
- Threat: Annie's point-and-click stun combo one-shots you if Tibbers lands; respect her range.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; Annie outranges and out-damages you; farm from max distance.
- Trading: Bait her Q with movement, then trade back; never fight when Tibbers ready.
- Post6: Annie becomes lethal with Tibbers engage; play 800+ units away when stun bar full.
- Spike: Annie spikes hardest at Lost Chapter; punish her pre-6 before she deals real damage.
- Window: Abuse Annie before level 6; her cooldowns are long early; kite and poke safely.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny her all-in angles; keep minions near your tower for safety.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite her combo and reposition after her stun lands.
- Item: Hexdrinker early blocks Tibbers burst and gives you survivability against her spike.

sivir__gwen.notes:
- Gwen's all-in burst with needlework passive shreds you; respect her range and damage.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm from max range, avoid her W bush control entirely.
- Bait her W, then trade back hard with Q; never fight inside her mist.
- Post-6 her ult gives mobility and damage; kite backwards, use E to block bolts.
- First Nashors spike around 10 minutes is dangerous; respect her sustained damage and duel power.
- Mid-game teamfights are your window; group early before she snowballs and picks isolated targets.
- Slow-push waves to deny her all-in opportunities; create space and force her to follow.
- Stormraider's Surge lets you kite her all-in attempts and dodge Needlework procs safely.
- Add Maw second or third item for magic resist and shield against her burst.

sivir__orianna.notes:
- threat: Orianna Command Attack poke forces you back; her ultimate teamfight disruption ends you
- early: Safe farm at distance; abuse your range advantage before she hits level 2
- trading: Dodge her ball attacks; bait her Command Attack then riposte with Boomerang Blade
- post6: Shockwave becomes lethal teamfight tool; position far back and never cluster with allies
- spike: Her Luden's/Liandry's spike hurts; respect the damage but farm safely outside her range
- window: You outrange her significantly; abuse this early game to farm freely and build leads
- wave: Slow-push sideways; forces her to overextend for farm or lose CS safely
- rune: Stormraider's Surge; kite away from her ball and escape ganks more reliably always
- item: Maw of Malmortius; blocks her burst and shields you against repeated ball poke spam

shen__rakan.notes:
- Rakan's engage with Xayah creates kill pressure; dodge his dash-knockup combo always
- Play safe levels 1-3; Rakan early trades hurt and his support amplifies damage
- Bait his W dash out, then trade back; never all-in into his cooldowns
- Taunt becomes easier post-6; use ultimate to counter-engage when he commits to fight
- His first item spike is dangerous; play defensive until you finish Hollow Radiance
- You spike when he wastes cooldowns; punish with taunt and sustained damage then
- Slow-push to deny him engage angles; let minions build near your tower for safety
- Grasp sustains through poke and converts short trades into health advantage reliably
- Force of Nature reduces his magic damage and gives movement speed for kiting

drmundo__akshan.notes:
- Akshan's grappling hook and burst damage catch you out of position; respect range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with cleaver, avoid walking into hook range.
- Bait his hook by moving unpredictably; trade after he misses or uses it.
- Akshan gains kill threat at six with revive ultimate; play safer, use ult defensively.
- His first item spike (crit/lethality) around 10-12 minutes forces you to respect damage heavily.
- You spike harder at level 11 with ultimate; leverage tankiness to teamfight and sustain.
- Slow-push side lanes to create space; avoid staying in river where hooks land easily.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and health scaling to survive his poke and burst.
- Build Force of Nature second or third to reduce his magic and physical damage.

drmundo__ivern.notes:
- Ivern's root and kite potential prevent you from engaging; avoid his Rootcaller projectile completely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ivern outranges you and pokes freely—farm under tower when pressured.
- Never chase Ivern through brush; bait his root by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's down.
- Post-6 his Daisy gives him peel and damage; respect the ultimate and don't overcommit fights.
- Ivern's first Mythic spike (typically Mandate) makes him annoying; use this window to scale instead.
- You spike when Ivern runs out of mana or cooldowns—punish extended fights after he wastes abilities.
- Slow-push waves into him; he can't shove you under tower and you build kill pressure.
- Take Grasp for sustain and HP scaling; you need durability to survive his poke consistently.
- Buy Abyssal Mask second; reduces his magic damage and gives you MR to survive his burst.

drmundo__fiddlesticks.notes:
- Fiddlesticks fears nothing early but his fear and silence lock you down completely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm range, never chase. Expect jungle pressure around lane.
- Dodge his E fear by playing behind minions; bait it, then all-in with Q.
- Post-6 his ultimate fear is instant death for you if caught; respect brush control.
- His first Liandry's or Protobelt spike hurts but Dr. Mundo sustain mitigates it well.
- You spike when he's on cooldown post-fear; run him down with Q spam.
- Slow-push to deny him brush control and prevent ganks from covering lane gaps.
- Grasp sustains through poke and procs easily; stick with it for survival pressure.
- Buy Adaptive Helm fourth to neuter his DOT damage and spirit fire interaction.

shen__shyvana.notes:
- Shyvana all-ins with sustained DPS; her mana-free kit makes extended fights deadly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her sustained damage and avoid extended trades early.
- Bait her Q cooldown, then trade back; dodge her E flames when possible.
- Post-6 her ult mobility lets her chase; use Taunt to stop engage attempts.
- Her first item spike (Sunfire or Riftmaker) is dangerous; punish her base return.
- You spike when she commits to all-in; Taunt stops her momentum and turns fights.
- Slow-push to deny her gank setup; maintain minion advantage without overextending into her range.
- Grasp sustains through her poke and strengthens your short trades; synergizes with Taunt engage.
- Spirit Visage bolsters your sustain and blocks her true damage, then stack into tank items.

shen__syndra.notes:
- Syndra's long-range stun and burst eliminate you before taunt lands; respect her range always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm from distance, dodge her Q, never walk into stun range.
- Bait her E with positioning, then all-in when cooldown burns; dodge Q projectiles consistently.
- Post-6 you ult away her burst; she cannot solo-kill you anymore if you respect range.
- First item spike (Lost Chapter) hurts; farm safely and scale, don't fight her directly yet.
- Your window opens mid-game when teammates group; use ult to enable teamfights, not duel her.
- Slow-push side lanes to space from her; rotate to teamfights where range matters less for you.
- Take Grasp; sustained trading wins long lanes, and you scale better than her poke damage.
- Rush Hollow Radiance second or third; her burst damage matters less when you have flat resistances.

drmundo__hecarim.notes:
- Hecarim's burst damage and kite potential with MS boost threaten your ability to retaliate effectively
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his all-in potential and farm at range with cleaver
- Bait his E charge, then counter-trade with Q and Mundo ult when he commits
- Hecarim ult dramatically increases his chase and burst; respect it and play around cooldown
- His first item spike (Trinity/Divine) is dangerous; avoid extended fights until you complete Hollow Radiance
- You spike harder mid-game when tanky; force extended teamfights where his burst window expires
- Slow-push to stack wave; prevents his roam while you scale into unkillable late-game teamfight threat
- Take Grasp for sustain in poke trades; helps you survive his mid-game spike window
- Add Adaptive Helm second or third if Hecarim builds heavy AP or continues one-shotting attempts

sivir__veigar.notes:
- Threat: Veigar's Event Horizon cage traps you; his ult deletes you if caught.
- Early: Safe farm levels 1-3; stay outside his Q range, respect his all-in.
- Trading: Dodge his Q with Sivir E; never fight inside potential cage zones.
- Post6: Veigar ult becomes execute threat; play further back, respect ultimate range always.
- Spike: First item spike (Lost Chapter) dangerous; he gains consistent mana and poke.
- Window: Mid-game before he scales; abuse mobility and teamfight range advantage early fights.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes; avoid clustering mid where cage traps multiple teammates easily.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite and escape cage; essential for survivability here.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius blocks ult damage and shields you from burst.

sivir__yorick.notes:
- Yorick cages you with wall; you cannot kite or dash out safely.
- Play safe at range; don't walk up for CS near minion wave.
- Dodge his E shovel toss; bait it out before trading autos back.
- His ult traps you; stay grouped and kite away from isolated targets.
- Trinity spike around 10-12 minutes; farm safely, don't fight in lane then.
- Mid-game teamfights where you group five-man; Yorick splits and you outscale.
- Slow-push to prevent him freezing near his tower; maintain safety distance always.
- Stormraider's Surge gives you escape tool when he closes distance aggressively.
- Kaenic Destructive Band cuts his healing; splash works against walls and cages.

sivir__pyke.notes:
- Threat: Pyke's hook stun into all-in burst combo one-shots you instantly
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm from max range, dodge hook constantly
- Trading: Never trade back after Pyke misses hook; bait his Q then punish
- Post6: Respect execute ult range; stay grouped or hug tower; never overextend alone
- Spike: Pyke spikes harder with first item; play passive until you complete mythic
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where you kite backward; punish if Pyke uses hook poorly
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes; group for objectives; avoid fighting in river or jungle
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite and escape hooks when he commits
- Item: Maw of Malmortius blocks execute damage and provides survivability early

sivir__kayn.notes:
- Kayn's all-in melee burst after Shadow Assassin transform kills you before escaping.
- Play safe behind minions; Kayn weak early, farm freely but watch river.
- Dodge his Shadow Step engage; use Ricochet to trade safely at range.
- Shadow Assassin form makes him lethal—group mid, never isolate in side lanes.
- First item spike (~10min) is minor; exploit pre-transform window to scale safely.
- Post-teamfight window when Kayn cooldowns down; position to punish him returning.
- Slow-push waves to deny him isolation picks; keep minion advantage nearby always.
- Stormraider's Surge gives you kite tools; escape his all-in and chase pressure.
- Quicksilver Sash stops his transform follow-up and ganks; slot after core two items.

sivir__rumble.notes:
- Rumble's flamespurt and overheated melee range delete you; respect his threat bubble.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm from max range with auto-attacks only.
- Dodge flamespurt with sidestep movement; never trade into his melee range willingly.
- Post-6 his ultimate zoning becomes oppressive; play around fog of war carefully.
- Rumble first item spike (Protobelt) is dangerous; play safer, don't overextend mid.
- Your window is before he gets overheated; kite backward when he commits.
- Slow-push sidewaves; let Rumble push mid into you for jungle ganks setup.
- Take Stormraider's Surge; it lets you kite away from his melee range threat.
- Buy KaenicOughtsword early; reduces his burn damage and gives you survivability.

sivir__vayne.notes:
- Vayne's Condemn stun into Silver Bolts true damage bursts you down extremely fast
- Play safe behind minions; avoid pushing up alone; respect her all-in threat level
- Don't trade short; bait her Condemn into walls then counter-trade with Sivir Q
- Post-six her invisibility gaps you for free; play safer; position near teammates always
- Her first-item Kraken spike is dangerous; back off and farm safer during this window
- Mid-game teamfights where you position well behind frontline; her range can't reach you
- Slow-push waves to stack them; forces her to choose between farm and roaming
- Grasp sustain lets you survive her poke and all-in attempts; outscale her trades
- Maw of Malmortius gives shield and spell vamp; reduces her burst threat significantly

sivir__tahmkench.notes:
- Tahm Kench's Eat ability locks you down; respect his engage range and cc threat.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at distance and dodge his Tongue Lash harass attempts.
- Bait out his Tongue Lash, then trade back with autos; never eat his combos.
- Post-6 Tahm becomes a roaming threat; play safer and spam ping missing alerts immediately.
- His Abyssal Mask first spike hurts; punish him before completion by spacing and poking.
- You spike harder mid-game with items; group with team and abuse range advantage then.
- Slow-push into him to control distance and deny his all-in; maintain spacing buffer always.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for kiting potential and escape safety against his heavy engage tools.
- Build Adaptive Helm as third or fourth item to reduce his sustained damage output.

sivir__lux.notes:
- Lux's E root and Q combo chain-CC you; dodge E or die to burst follow-up
- Play safe behind minions levels 1-3; her E outranges your auto-attack, punish her if she misses
- Bait her E with movement, then all-in her before Q lands; never trade into both spells
- Respect her ultimate at 6; position near walls to block it, don't get caught isolated mid
- Her first Liandry spike hurts; farm safely, don't fight—wait until you have mythic item advantage
- Post-mythic you outduel her; catch her if she overextends, then run her down with kiting
- Slow-push to stack waves; force her to clear with spells, then roam with your lead
- Take Stormraider's Surge; you need the MS to kite her CC and escape her burst combos
- Add Hexdrinker early if she snowballs; protects you from her burst and delays her damage spike

sivir__mel.notes:
- Mel's point-blank engage and sustained damage output will delete you if caught.
- Play safe levels 1-3; abuse range advantage with Q poke, respect her all-in.
- Bait her W shield with Q trades, then all-in when it's down.
- Mel gains kill pressure with ultimate; play further back, use Spellshield reactively.
- Her first item spike is real danger; farm safely and avoid extended fights.
- You spike harder mid-game with items; group and use range to kite.
- Slow-push sideways; deny her engage angle while keeping escape route open always.
- Stormraider's Surge gives you kite and escape tool against her relentless close range.
- Grab Maw of Malmortius early if she snowballs; shields help survive her burst.

sivir__tryndamere.notes:
- Tryndamere's all-in melee engagement with high crit damage and sustain kills unprepared Sivir fast.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with autos, avoid pushing into him aggressively.
- Bait his engage with Sivir's mobility, then trade back with Q poke from distance.
- Post-6 his ultimate makes him unkillable; don't fight him alone, group with teammates always.
- His first item spike (usually Shojin or Crit) is dangerous; farm safely and scale instead.
- Sivir punishes him when teammates are nearby for ganks or when he overextends mid-wave.
- Slow-push waves to maintain distance and set up ganks; avoid hard-pushing into his threat range.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite and escape his engage attempts; mobility keeps you alive.
- Consider Plated Steelcaps early if he snowballs; armor reduces his crit damage substantially.

sivir__tristana.notes:
- Threat: Tristana's all-in burst and knockback ult delete you if you're caught without Spellshield up.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; respect her jump range and only CS when her E is down.
- Trading: Bait her jump with positioning, then Spellshield her follow-up and trade back with Q bounces.
- Post6: Her ult becomes a kill threat; never get caught without Spellshield or a clear escape path.
- Spike: First item (likely Manamune or Kraken) is dangerous; respect her damage window and play safer.
- Window: Mid-game teamfights where you kite backward and spam Spellshield rotations; she lacks mobility then.
- Wave: Slow-push to deny her all-ins; prevents her from forcing engages with man-advantage positioning nearby.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite her engage attempts and escape her ult knockback range safely.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius gives you lifeline shield to survive her all-in burst attempts reliably.

sivir__naafiri.notes:
- Naafiri's pack coordination and burst damage in extended fights overwhelm Sivir's defenses.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her all-in potential and farm at distance with Q.
- Dodge her Q poke; bait Naafiri into overextending then trade with W safely.
- Post-6 Naafiri gains map pressure and execution threat; play safer and group earlier.
- Her first item spike (Manamune or Serrated) is dangerous; respect damage and kite back.
- Sivir gains window post-first-item when Naafiri lacks waveclear; push waves and roam mid.
- Push waves hard to deny Naafiri pack engage; don't let her set fights.
- Use Lethal Tempo for extended fight scaling or Stormraider's Surge to kite her.
- Buy Maw or Force of Nature early if burst becomes unmanageable for survivability.

drmundo__annie.notes:
- Annie's burst combo and stun lock you down; her Tibbers ignite amplifies all damage taken.
- Play safe levels 1-3; her Q auto-reset chunks hard. Farm with Cleaver from range carefully.
- Bait her stun by moving unpredictably, then all-in with Cleaver spam when her stun depletes.
- Annie level 6 Tibbers turns fights; you need teammates or accept farming until tankier.
- Annie first item spike (Luden's or Protobelt) around 10 minutes hurts; farm safely, don't fight.
- Post-first-item, you outscale her; your sustained tankiness beats her burst as you build resistances.
- Slow-push waves into her; forces her to farm or roam, denying her jungle setup.
- Grasp for sustain and short-trade damage; proc repeatedly to offset her poke and burst.
- Abyssal Mask early neutralizes her magic damage; build after Hollow Radiance for maximum efficiency.

drmundo__sejuani.notes:
- Sejuani's CC chain and engage lock you down; her ult guarantees your death if caught
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her all-in potential and farm from distance with cleaver
- Bait her stun with movement; trade back when cooldown expires; never fight in her passive
- Her ult transforms the lane into a gank setup; play defensive and track her roams
- Watch for Sunfire Aegis spike around 10 minutes; play back but don't get zoned completely
- You scale better late; farm safely until items give you healing advantage and tankiness
- Slow-push into her to control tempo; prevents her from roaming and forces farming commitment
- Take Grasp for sustained trading advantage; scales your tankiness and matches her durability better
- Buy Force of Nature if she stacks AP or lethality is heavy; boosts MR significantly

drmundo__nocturne.notes:
- Nocturne's all-in burst and fear lock you down; you can't kite or escape his combo.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at range with Cleaver, avoid pushing; respect his all-in threat.
- Bait his fear with your body; trade only after his Duskbringer cooldown; play around waves.
- Post-6 Nocturne ult removes vision; you become his priority target; group and play safer.
- His first Eclipse spike (1100 gold) is dangerous; play defensive; your power comes later at items.
- After Liandry's or second item, you outduel him; abuse extended fights in lane or teamfights.
- Slow-push waves into him; deny his roam timer and prevent his level-6 ult from snowballing.
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke; it lets you heal harass and win extended trades.
- Consider Kaenic Orb early if burst threatens; its magic damage reduction counters his Duskbringer poke.

shen__ezreal.notes:
- Ezreal kites you relentlessly with Q spam while staying safe behind minions always.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Ezreal outranges you heavily, so respect his poke damage.
- Bait his Q cooldown, then all-in with E+Q; dodge his return shots by moving.
- Post-6 his ultimate creates distance; use your ulti to save teammates he threatens instead.
- First Sheen spike (1100g) hurts; respect his damage but this window favors your all-in.
- Level 6+ you spike harder; look for side-lane fights where he cannot kite freely.
- Slow-push into him; forces him to farm close to your tower and limits his space.
- Take Grasp for tankiness and healing pressure; sustain through his poke damage effectively.
- Buy Hollow Radiance third against his poke; reduces his damage output meaningfully when stacked.

shen__renekton.notes:
- Renekton's all-in burst with Fury empowered abilities kills you if you overextend or get cornered.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his Dash attempts and farm at max range with Q.
- Bait his Dash, then trade back with Q-auto; never let him stack Fury freely.
- Post-6 his ultimate makes him tankier and stronger; use Taunt to interrupt his all-in.
- Renekton's Triforce spike around 10-12 minutes is dangerous; respect his damage and play safer.
- You spike when Renekton runs low on Fury or after he wastes his Dash.
- Slow-push to deny him all-in angles and control when he can force extended trades.
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke damage; it keeps you healthier through his harassment.
- Build Hollow Radiance early if he stacks armor pen; it reduces his burst significantly.

shen__sylas.notes:
- Sylas all-ins with E-W combo; his sustain and burst deny your poke trades safely
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his E range and avoid clumping near minions for his grab
- Bait his E forward, then taunt him during cooldown; never trade into his W heal
- His ult stealing Stand United turns fights; play around fog of war and don't get caught
- His first Mythic (typically Everfrost) at six items spikes damage; abuse him before completion
- Post-6 when his ult is down or if you dodge E; that's your all-in window
- Slow-push early; denies his E engagement range and stacks waves for jungle ganks
- Take Grasp for sustained trading; the healing keeps you healthy through his poke and sustain
- Add Spirit Visage third or fourth; its healing boost counters his burst and sustain alike

shen__ahri.notes:
- Threat: Ahri's charm lands, you're dead or forced to ult defensively immediately
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her charm range outmatches your engage tools significantly
- Trading: Bait her charm with positioning, then all-in; never trade without this setup
- Post6: She gains massive kill pressure and escape; respect her ult range always
- Spike: First item spike dangerous; she'll have charm + damage to burst you
- Window: Post-Mythic when you outduel her; abuse level advantage windows before her scaling
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; denies her charm angles while you farm safely and scale
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge; kite away from charm and re-engage after cooldown expires safely
- Item: Kaenic Frostfire over Hollow Radiance; extra tankiness helps absorb her burst damage

shen__chogath.notes:
- Cho'Gath's Rupture silence and Feast execute delete you if caught; respect his combo range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm ranged, avoid short trades since he out-damages early with spikes.
- Bait Rupture by moving unpredictably, then trade back hard; dodge his Q and you win short.
- Post-6 Feast becomes a kill threat if you're low health; respect execute range and play safer.
- His first item spike (usually Rylai's or Liandry's) makes him tanky and sticky—punish before it completes.
- You spike harder mid-game with Hollow Radiance and Spirit Visage; abuse this window to pressure him.
- Slow-push into him so you control ganks and deny his all-in; freeze only if backed.
- Take Grasp for sustained trading and healing; sustain keeps you healthy for teamfights and split pressure.
- Add Force of Nature second or third for magic resist and movement speed against his sticky build.

shen__lulu.notes:
- Lulu's polymorph locks you down; you cannot taunt, dash, or fight while transformed
- Play safe levels 1-3; her poke range exceeds yours, avoid extended trades early
- Bait her polymorph with fake engages, then all-in when cooldown is down
- Post-6 Lulu becomes unkillable and protects allies; shift to macro pressure and side waves
- Her first item spike (usually Luden's or Zhonyas) is dangerous; respect her damage window
- Mid-game teamfights where Lulu uses ult poorly or polymorph is on cooldown are yours
- Slow-push to create a dive window; Lulu cannot solo-defend you without her jungler
- Grasp rewards short trades before her poke stacks; Stormraider's Surge lets you escape polymorph
- Mercury's Treads early or Abyssal Mask later reduce her polymorph and poke effectiveness

shen__yorick.notes:
- Yorick traps you in his cage, preventing taunt escape; respect wall engagement range always
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge his ghouls and avoid extended trades near minions
- Bait his E ghoul spawn, then taunt when he's vulnerable; dodge Q harass
- Post-6 his ult creates untargetable clone; taunt the real Yorick, ignore the spirit
- His first Sheen spike hurts; play safe, farm under tower, wait for your items
- Level 9+ you outscale massively; look for taunt combos when his cooldowns peak
- Freeze or slow-push near your tower; prevents him from caging you far from help
- Grasp sustains his poke and chunks him back; Stormraider's Surge lets you escape cages
- Force of Nature blocks his sustained damage; add it third or fourth item slot

sivir__locke.notes:
- Locke's long-range lockdown and burst through walls punishes immobile positioning hard.
- Play safe level 1-3; respect his poke range and dodge his projectiles carefully.
- Bait his dash cooldown, then trade with Q; never let him close gap freely.
- Post-6 his ult creates map pressure; stay grouped and watch for flank attempts.
- First item spike is dangerous; play passive until you complete mythic yourself for safety.
- Sivir spikes harder mid-game with crit; group and teamfight where mobility matters most.
- Push waves to deny him roam setup; deny his ability to set traps safely.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite away from his gap-close and survive all-in attempts.
- Build Maw second if he snowballs hard; the shield blocks his burst effectively.

sivir__teemo.notes:
- Teemo's blind dart negates your damage and auto-reliant trading patterns hard.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range with Q only.
- Never trade into his blind; bait it with fake autos first.
- Teemo gains map control and poke safety; respect shroom vision denial.
- Teemo's Nashor's Tooth first-spike window is real; abuse him pre-completion.
- Post-first-item Sivir outranges and outdamages; leverage your AD scaling advantage hard.
- Slow-push waves into tower; deny his all-in range and roam safety.
- Take Stormraider's Surge; kite away from blind and shrooms with speed.
- Build Manamune second if ahead; provides damage and sustain against poke.

sivir__caitlyn.notes:
- Caitlyn's headshot and superior range zones you off CS and pokes relentlessly.
- Play safe level 1-3; respect her range and only CS when she's last-hitting.
- Bait her trap placement, then use Sivir W to trade when she repositions.
- Her ultimate at six threatens all-ins; respect it and play further back.
- Her first Manamune spike hurts; abuse her mana costs before she gets it online.
- You spike harder with Mythic; shove and roam or force teamfights then.
- Slow-push to stack wave; forces Caitlyn to engage or lose CS.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite her and escape trap zones when needed.
- Buy Kaenic Lifeline early if Caitlyn ult keeps threatening you or killing teammates.

sivir__ekko.notes:
- Ekko's burst combo and % health damage delete you if you get caught close range
- Play safe behind minions; farm at max range with Q; respect his level 2 all-in
- Bait his W with positioning; dodge his E engage; trade only when his cooldowns down
- His ultimate gives him escape and repositioning; you lose all-in fights post-6 completely
- His first item spike (Protobelt or Nashors) is dangerous; respect the burst window hard
- Sivir spikes when Ekko wastes ultimate; punish with sustained damage and kite away cleanly
- Slow-push early to deny his roams and gank setup; maintain safety in numbers
- Grasp gives you sustain to survive his poke; Stormraider's Surge lets you kite escapes
- Manamune or Black Cleaver gives you better duel potential; slot after mythic defensively

sivir__pantheon.notes:
- Pantheon's point-blank spear stun combos delete you; respect his all-in range always
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge spears, farm from max range, never walk up
- Bait his spear with movement, then trade back with autos when it's down
- Post-6 his ult ganks win him the map; group and play safer mid-game
- His first item spike (Prowler's) is dangerous; respect all-in windows and play back
- You outscale hard late-game; farm safely, survive early, teamfight with ult shield value
- Slow-push to deny his all-in range and create gank-setup opportunities for your jungler
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke trading; Stormraider's Surge works if you need escape
- Grab Kaenic Lifeline for survivability; the shield helps you survive his burst combo

drmundo__milio.notes:
- Milio's poke and healing sustain make him extremely hard to bully or all-in effectively
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect his range and poke damage, farm from distance only
- Avoid trading into his Warmемory; bait his abilities then all-in with Cleaver and Zombie
- Post-6, his ultimate shield and healing counter your sustained damage; play around cooldowns
- First item spike (Moonstone or Chemtech) strengthens his healing; play safer, don't force fights
- Spike at level 9+ when Cleaver maxes; increased shred and damage output beats his healing
- Slow-push to stack minions; forces Milio to choose between poke and wave management pressures
- Take Grasp for sustain and poke trading to match his harassment and scale better
- Consider Force of Nature third item to reduce his healing effectiveness against your damage

drmundo__zeri.notes:
- Zeri's all-in burst and sustained damage with Q spam overwhelms your defenses instantly.
- Play safe, farm at distance, avoid extended trades. Let her push; use cleaver poke.
- Dodge her E charges; bait her into overcommitting, then all-in with ultimate ready.
- Her ultimate gives her kiting power and damage—respect it, don't chase; position carefully.
- First item spike (usually Trinity) is dangerous; respect her damage and play passive briefly.
- You spike harder mid-game with tankiness items; abuse this to zone and duel her.
- Slow-push to maintain pressure, deny her gank setup, and scale toward your power windows.
- Grasp provides sustain against her poke and scales into late-game tankiness you desperately need.
- Force of Nature blocks her magic damage and gives you the movement speed she denies.

drmundo__locke.notes:
- Locke's chain root locks you down; you can't kite or escape ganks easily after caught
- Play safe early; respect his all-in range and chain threat; farm from distance with cleaver
- Bait his chain by moving unpredictably, then all-in when it's on cooldown; dodge root always
- His ult pressures you hard; play around cooldown timers and don't commit when it's ready
- First item spike is dangerous; play defensive until you complete your first major item then match
- Your power window opens mid-game when tanky; group fights favor you if chains are dodged
- Slow-push into him to create gank pressure; avoid hard pushes that let him roam freely
- Grasp of the Undying gives sustain against poke and scales better into teamfights than alternatives
- Consider Silvermere Dawn early if chain root becomes unmanageable; cleanse the root effect on demand

drmundo__gragas.notes:
- Gragas body slams you away from CS and combos burst damage; respect his engage range.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm from distance and avoid pushing; let Gragas come to you.
- Bait his body slam, then trade back hard with cleavers; never eat free poke.
- Post-6, Gragas ult can yeet you into his team; respect the displacement threat entirely.
- First Liandry's spike hurts; farm safely and don't fight him isolated during this window.
- Dr. Mundo spikes harder mid-game; use tankiness advantage to engage teamfights and punish squishies.
- Slow-push waves to control jungle proximity; prevents Gragas from using ult to set up ganks.
- Take Grasp for sustain and scaling; grants health stacking against Gragas' poke and burst.
- Add Force of Nature if Gragas gets fed; the MR and move speed counter him.

sivir__gragas.notes:
- Gragas all-in combo with E-Q-W chunks you hard; respect his engage range always
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm from distance, dodge his Q barrels, respect level 2
- Bait his E cooldown before trading; dodge barrel with your own mobility, then punish
- Gragas gains kill pressure post-6; his ult displaces you—position near walls cautiously always
- Watch first item spike around level 9; abuse him pre-Mythic when he's weakest
- You spike harder with Mythic and Manamune; kite and auto him down then
- Slow-push side lanes; force him to rotate and waste time catching dying minions
- Grasp gives sustain but Stormraider's Surge lets him chase; predict and respect the choice
- Maw of Malmortius adds magic resist; delays burst and lets you survive his combo

sivir__yuumi.notes:
- Yuumi empowers her ally with on-hit damage and CC; respect coordinated all-ins.
- Play safe level 1-3; Yuumi's ally gets stronger—farm defensively, avoid extended trades.
- Bait Yuumi's Q with movement, then trade back; dodge her root carefully.
- Yuumi ult becomes major threat; position carefully and respect her team's engage range.
- First item spike (often Moonstone) empowers ally significantly; play safer, scale up instead.
- Mid-game teamfights where Yuumi separated or immobile; capitalize on her vulnerability windows.
- Slow-push waves to control spacing; deny enemy roam pressure and all-in attempts.
- Stormraider's Surge for kiting safety when Yuumi's ally engages; mobility counters their coordination.
- Quicksilver Sash early if Yuumi ult threatens you repeatedly; cleanse is invaluable here.

sivir__masteryi.notes:
- Master Yi all-ins you post-6 with untargetable alpha strike; you die instantly if caught.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm at max range with autos, avoid pushing into river.
- Bait alpha strike with a ricochet, then trade back hard; dodge his engage.
- Post-6, Master Yi becomes lethal; play near tower and respect his ultimate cooldown.
- His first item spike (usually Kraken) is dangerous; punish him before he finishes it.
- You spike harder at two items; look to group and siege before his powerspike.
- Slow-push to deny his roams; keep him farming under tower, reducing his impact.
- Lethal Tempo gives you duel tools; take it to kite and survive all-ins better.
- Buy Maw of Malmortius second or third; the shield and magic resist save your life.

sivir__drmundo.notes:
- Threat: Dr. Mundo's sustained damage and tankiness let him all-in you without consequence easily.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm with Q from distance, avoid his cleavers always.
- Trading: Bait his cleaver, then trade back hard; dodge with E if he commits.
- Post6: His ult sustain makes him unkillable in extended fights; kite and disengage always.
- Spike: His first item spike (usually Adaptive Helm) is dangerous; respect his tankiness spike.
- Window: Your advantage comes mid-game when teammates group; punish him away from teamfights.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes; force him to choose between farming and grouping for fights.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite his gap-close attempts and escape his all-ins.
- Item: Manamune gives sustained poke damage to wear him down from safe distance safely.

sivir__yone.notes:
- Yone's all-in with E-Q3 combo one-shots you; respect his range and positioning always
- Play safe level 1-3; use W to farm from distance, never walk up carelessly
- Bait his E with positioning, then trade back hard with W when he commits
- Post-6 Yone becomes lethal; respect his ultimate engage range, position near walls or teammates
- First item spike (Trinity/Sheen) makes him dangerous; punish him before completion with poke
- You spike harder mid-game with items; group and abuse teamfights when he splits
- Slow-push to control wave near your tower; deny his flanking angles and gank setups
- Stormraider's Surge lets you kite and escape his E-Q chains; take it over Grasp here
- Build Maw of Malmortius second or third; blocks his burst and gives you survivability

sivir__ashe.notes:
- Threat: Ashe's Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns you from range; respect her positioning always
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; her range dominates early trades, focus on last-hitting
- Trading: Dodge her W with your Spell Shield; only trade when her cooldowns are down
- Post6: Her ultimate becomes a kill threat; respect her positioning and play toward fog of war
- Spike: Ashe spikes at first item; play safer and respect her burst damage window
- Window: You spike harder at three items; group and use your speed to close fights
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes; build advantages before she groups with her team's utility
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite away from Ashe ganks and her aggressive trading
- Item: Add Maw of Malmortius if Ashe's team has AP threats affecting your survival

sivir__aurelionsol.notes:
- Aurelion Sol's star damage and extended range poke wear you down; dodge his stars.
- Play safe level 1-3; farm from max range with Q, avoid trading inside star radius.
- Bait his stars to one side, then reposition; never trade while centered in orbit.
- Post-6 his ult creates escape windows for him; respect his burst and kite backward.
- First item spike (Luden's) around 10-12 minutes hurts; play safer and farm with abilities.
- Sivir spikes when Aurelion Sol overextends past river; all-in with Ricochet and E shield.
- Push the wave hard to deny him roam pressure; he struggles into pushed lanes.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for movement to dodge stars and chase when he gets caught.
- Buy Force of Nature early if he stacks magic damage; maintain stat efficiency overall.

sivir__seraphine.notes:
- Seraphine's poke and CC chain from her abilities will zone you from farm safely.
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her range and dodge her Q skillshots consistently.
- Bait her E root, then trade back with your Q; avoid her W healing.
- Post-6 her ult creates engage threat; play around walls and respect the CC range.
- Her first item (Liandry's or Luden's) spike hurts; don't fight in her poke range.
- Sivir outpunishes her at 2-3 items when you have lifesteal and damage items.
- Slow-push waves to avoid her setup; deny her grouped teamfight engage opportunities.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite her CC and escape her ultimate engage attempts.
- Add Maw or Adaptive helm early if her poke threatens your laning survival.

sivir__nunuwillump.notes:
- Nunu & Willump's Snowball engage catches you immobile; dodge or die immediately every fight.
- Play safe levels 1-3; farm distant minions, avoid river, respect his level 2 all-in.
- Bait his Snowball with position, then Spellshield it or sidestep; trade after cooldown.
- Post-6 his ultimate roots you hard; position near walls to limit Absolute Zero damage.
- First item spike around 6-8 minutes is dangerous; respect his engage and farm safer.
- Your window is when his Snowball is down; push and damage him aggressively then.
- Slow-push or freeze near tower; prevents his engage setup and denies him roam.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for mobility to kite and escape his engage attempts cleanly.
- Buy Quicksilver Sash second or third item to cleanse his ult root early.

drmundo__poppy.notes:
- Poppy's hammer stun and repositioning wall pins lock you down for burst damage
- Play safe levels 1-3; respect her all-in near walls and minion spacing carefully
- Bait her hammer swing, then trade back; dodge her stun around terrain always
- Post-6 her ult repositioning makes ganks harder; your ultimate still provides teamfight sustain advantage
- First item spike around 10-12 minutes is real danger; play safer and respect range
- Dr. Mundo spikes harder mid-game with health scaling; abuse this window around 20+ minutes
- Slow-push waves into her; deny her wall-pin angles and force her forward mistakes
- Take Grasp for extended trade sustain; it outscales her poke and sustains tank items
- Add Adaptive Helm after core; reduces her hammer damage and gives you magic resist advantage

drmundo__jayce.notes:
- Jayce's ranged poke and gate-enhanced damage burst you down before you sustain back
- Play safe behind minions; dodge his ranged Q; don't trade early—he wins short fights
- Bait his E gate placement, then all-in when cooldown is down; respect his damage
- You outscale significantly; his burst matters less when you're tanky; farm safely until then
- His first item spike (Manamune or Serrated) hurts—play ultra-safe; your window comes later
- Mid-game teamfights when you're tanky enough; he can't burst or control you anymore
- Slow-push waves to build a minion advantage; force him to choose between poke and farm
- Grasp for sustain and scaling; it outvalues Stormraider's Surge since you need bulk early
- Adaptive Helm or Force of Nature blocks his poke pattern and reduces burst threat significantly

sivir__amumu.notes:
- Amumu's Curse of the Sad Mummy stun locks you; dodge engage or kite backward hard.
- Play safe behind minions; Amumu has no ranged threat early but scales into terror.
- Bait Bandage Toss with positioning, then punish his long cooldown with auto-attacks and Q.
- Post-six Amumu becomes a one-man teamfight tool; never group without escape plan ready.
- Amumu first-item spike (Liandry's or Rylai's) threatens close fights; keep distance, abuse range advantage.
- Your power window is levels 1-5 before his ultimate; trade and damage heavily then.
- Slow-push into tower to deny Amumu flank angles; prevent him from roaming with pressure.
- Grab Stormraider's Surge to kite his engage and escape Curse stun radius without dying.
- Build Manamune second for mana and damage; gives you dueling power against tanky Amumu.

sivir__yasuo.notes:
- Yasuo dashes through your Spell Shield, then ults you into his team for instant deletion.
- Play safe, farm at max range with autos only. Never push; let him engage first.
- Bait his Q3 tornado with movement, then trade back with W while he recovers cooldown.
- His ult becomes lethal; stay grouped and never get caught alone without Spell Shield ready.
- Sheen + Manamune spike (level 9) is dangerous; respect his all-in and play further back.
- Post-11 when you have Manamune, you outrange and outdamage him; abuse this window hard.
- Push and crash waves into tower; denies him jungle ganks and forces him to overextend.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite and escape his dashes; safety over damage in this matchup.
- Build Maw of Malmortius as third item; the shield blocks his ult burst completely.

sivir__zilean.notes:
- Zilean's double bomb combo and time bomb slow lock you down for ganks and burst.
- Play safe level one; dodge his bombs and farm from distance with Q bounces.
- Never fight near minions; bait his bombs then trade after they're on cooldown briefly.
- His ultimate denies your kill pressure but doesn't stop your teamfight damage output directly.
- His first item spike (Liandry's or Luden's) hurts; use it as your roam window.
- You spike hardest mid-game when teamfights matter more than his poke; abuse grouping advantage.
- Slow-push waves to deny him roam pressure while maintaining safety from his bomb range.
- Stormraider's Surge lets you escape bomb chains and kite his slow; take it consistently.
- Add Maw second or third item if he's ahead; sustains you through poke damage.

sivir__udyr.notes:
- Udyr's sustained close-range damage and gap-closing speed will kill you if caught.
- Play safe early; farm at max range with autos, avoid pushing too hard.
- Dodge his Tiger stance trades by backing away; bait Phoenix for mana drain.
- Post-6, Udyr gains mobility tool—respect his engage range, position near jungle exits.
- Udyr's Trinity spike around 10-12 minutes is dangerous; punish him before completion.
- After Level 11, you outrange and kite him; farm safely and scale up.
- Slow-push sideways; prevents Udyr from roaming freely while keeping him in lane.
- Stormraider's Surge lets you kite his sustained damage and escape his close-range engage.
- Add Manamune early if falling behind; extra mana sustains trading and waveclear pressure.

sivir__fizz.notes:
- Fizz all-ins with Protobelt or ult; you die if caught without Spellshield up.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Fizz scales fast, so don't fight early trades unnecessarily.
- Bait his Ult before trading; use Spellshield reactively on his engage, not proactively.
- Post-6 Fizz becomes lethal; respect his all-in range and keep distance constantly.
- First item spike is dangerous; Fizz gains burst and dive tools around Protobelt.
- Mid-game teamfights favor Sivir once you have items; kite and spam Spellshield.
- Slow-push waves away from him; this denies dive angles and extends your safety.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite his engages and escape his Ult followup easily.
- Add Maw of Malmortius after core; it blocks burst and grants you survivability.

sivir__shaco.notes:
- threat: Shaco's burst from stealth and clone confuse you; dodge his burst or die fast
- early: Dangerous — play safe, ward river, avoid pushing; he ganks level 2-3 constantly hard
- trading: Bait his Q with positioning; use Boomerang Blade when he's visible attacking minions only
- post6: Sivir's ultimate lets you escape his clone pressure and rotation attempts; play more aggressive
- spike: First item spike (Duskblade) is his danger window; stay grouped, don't get caught alone
- window: After first back with Manamune or mythic, you duel him easier; abuse this timing
- wave: Slow-push side lanes, fast-push mid when he roams; deny his gank setup opportunities
- rune: Stormraider's Surge — kite away from his engage, escape clones, reset positioning constantly needed
- item: Quicksilver Sash or Maw later; cleanse his clone confusion and reduce his burst damage

sivir__jinx.notes:
- Threat: Jinx's rockets deal massive AOE damage; respect her range and burst from distance.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3. Farm under tower, avoid her Q poke range entirely.
- Trading: Dodge her rockets with Sivir E when she commits. Don't chase her backward.
- Post6: Her ultimate threatens you across map. Play safer, group with team, respect range.
- Spike: First item spike (Manamune or Kraken) is dangerous. Play passive, don't contest for kills.
- Window: You outscale mid-game when grouped. Teamfight with E ready; she struggles versus coordination.
- Wave: Slow-push side lanes. Avoid feeding rockets; group mid for objective control instead.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you kite and dodge rockets; safer than Grasp into poke.
- Item: Maw of Malmortius adds survivability against her burst before committing to damage items.

sivir__xerath.notes:
- Xerath's poke range and stun lock you down; dodge his Q and E relentlessly.
- Play safe levels 1-3; dodge backwards, use minions as cover, don't contest his poke.
- Bait his E stun by moving unpredictably; trade only after he wastes cooldowns.
- Xerath ult creates zone control; position behind minions and use Sivir ult to dodge.
- Luden's spike hurts; stay back and farm safely until you complete Manamune or mythic.
- Sivir's advantage comes post-teamfight when Xerath has no cooldowns; punish with cleanup damage.
- Slow-push to create gank opportunities; Xerath lacks mobility to help his jungler escape.
- Take Stormraider's Surge to kite away from his E stun and chase down kills.
- Build Adaptive Helm or Maw second to reduce his poke damage and increase tankiness.

sivir__rell.notes:
- Threat: Rell's mounted engage and CC chain locks you down; avoid getting caught out of position.
- Early: Play safe levels 1-3; farm from distance, don't contest brush; respect her all-in threat range.
- Trading: Dodge her mounted charge with Sivir's mobility; trade back only after she dismounts and wastes CC.
- Post6: Her ultimate lockdown becomes more dangerous; position further back and use Sivir ult to kite away.
- Spike: Watch her first item spike (likely tank); use this window to pressure and farm safely with range.
- Window: Punish Rell when mounted cooldown is down; she's immobile and vulnerable to your sustained damage then.
- Wave: Slow-push sideways; avoid extended stays mid; this prevents her from catching you and trapping you.
- Rune: Stormraider's Surge lets you escape her engage chain and reposition after she lands mounted charge.
- Item: Quicksilver Sash cleanses her CC chains; build it third if she becomes primary threat target.

sivir__warwick.notes:
- Warwick all-in and bloodhunt chase after landing Q; kite backwards relentlessly when marked.
- Play safe early; Warwick weak levels 1-3 so farm freely but watch positioning.
- Dodge his Q to avoid bloodhunt mark; bait it then trade with autos.
- Warwick ult forces you to Flash or position near walls; play safer post-6.
- Warwick first item spike around 1200 gold; punish him before Kindlegem powerspike hits.
- Sivir dominates mid-game teamfights with ult; engage when Warwick Q is down.
- Push lane to deny him gank setup; fast wave clear prevents his roams effectively.
- Take Stormraider's Surge for kiting Warwick down; escape his Q-mark chase attempts easily.
- Build Maw second if behind; gives you survivability against his burst and execute.

drmundo__skarner.notes:
- Skarner's point-and-click suppress ult removes your agency; position carefully away from walls.
- Play safe levels 1-3; Skarner out-damages early. Farm at range, avoid close trades.
- Bait his E stun with unpredictable movement; trade when his cooldowns are down.
- Post-6 becomes deadly; Skarner can suppress and drag you into his team.
- First Sheen spike hurts; respect his damage window and play defensive, farm safe.
- Power spike comes mid-game when you're tankier; abuse your sustain and teamfight durability.
- Slow-push toward enemy tower; keeps Skarner away from walls and limits ult threat.
- Run Grasp for sustained trading power and health scaling into a long matchup.
- Buy Abyssal Mask early; the magic resist and healing amplification counters his burst.
